output.brief: The crash gap is mostly not caused by the Tiled Canvas flag. Flagged users are all on build 7.4.0, since the flag only works there. Build 7.4.0 crashed at about 2% from 2 Sep, before the flag ramp, against about 0.7% on 7.3.2. Within 7.4.0, flagged users (2.10%) and the random flag-off holdout (1.98%) differ by only 0.12 points, which is within noise. Device mix and usage are the same across groups. The leading crash cluster, 41% of events, is a native crash in the upgraded image library (Pixelda), first seen 2 Sep. No canvas frames appear in the top clusters. The crash reporting is not inflating counts, because the app-store console agrees with it. The sync-service deploy has no effect on 7.3.2. Do not turn the flag off and release 7.4.0 to 100% on Friday. That would ship the real problem to everyone. Hold the rollout at 25%, and fix the image-library crash. Keep the existing holdout running, or widen it, to settle whether the flag adds a small effect of a few tenths of a point. I'm fairly confident, though a small flag effect is not ruled out.
